facts.fact: The town halls of Mayo-Oulo and Bibemi, in the North region, were each fitted with at least one Wi-Fi access point joined by a long-distance Wi-Fi link to the postal digital access point at Mayo-Oulo, which has fibre, and to the Bibemi community telecentre, under a pilot agreed between the telecommunications ministry and GIZ's PRADEC programme after studies in 2018, as APC's policy brief states; the brief gives no date for the installation, so the fact is dated to its publication in 2023, and it does not say who pays for the link.
facts.system: réseaux maillés Wi-Fi autour des télécentres (PRADEC)

facts.fact: The pilot networks at Mayo-Oulo and Bibemi give the connected sites, the two town halls among them, internet access and offline access to the GOON platform of local content, as APC's brief of 2023 states; it names no use by the town halls' staff and no national system worked in. Dated to publication.
facts.system: réseaux maillés Wi-Fi autour des télécentres (PRADEC)

facts.fact: Two communes' town halls, Mayo-Oulo and Bibemi, are named as sites connected by the pilot networks, among 4 sites at Mayo-Oulo and the sites listed at Bibemi, on APC's brief of 2023; no total of communes connected is given. Dated to publication.
facts.system: réseaux maillés Wi-Fi autour des télécentres (PRADEC)

facts.fact: PRADEC, run by GIZ under the ministry of decentralisation, bought the equipment, installed the pilot networks, trained the telecentre managers and supports monitoring and maintenance, while the telecommunications ministry eased use of the Wi-Fi bands, licensing and access to fibre, and the communes of Mayo Oulo and Bibemi mobilised residents and repaired the telecentre buildings, as APC's brief of 2023 states. Dated to publication.
facts.system: réseaux maillés Wi-Fi autour des télécentres (PRADEC)

facts.fact: The equipment of the pilot networks that reach the two town halls was acquired by GIZ's PRADEC programme, the only funder the brief of 2023 names for them; the brief adds that telecommunications is not a power transferred to local authorities, so their own funds cannot be used for such networks. Dated to publication.
